title: Oklahoma Beats Oklahoma State 47-41 on November 27, 2010
question: What was the score of the Oklahoma vs. Oklahoma State Bedlam game on November 27, 2010?
answer: On November 27, 2010, Oklahoma beat Oklahoma State 47-41 in Stillwater. Landry Jones threw for 468 yards, and the win left the Sooners, Cowboys and Texas A&M tied atop the Big 12 South.
summary: On this date in 2010, Oklahoma outlasted Oklahoma State 47-41 in Stillwater as Landry Jones passed for 468 yards, forcing a three-way Big 12 South tie.
body: On this date in 2010, Oklahoma traveled to Stillwater for the 105th Bedlam game and left with a 47-41 win. The Cowboys were ranked ahead of the Sooners, and ESPN's College GameDay was on site.

Oklahoma led 24-17 at halftime, but the teams were tied 24-24 after three quarters. The fourth quarter then turned into a shootout. The Sooners added three field goals, and the teams traded touchdowns within about 92 seconds, including a kickoff return for a score by Oklahoma State's Justin Gilbert.

The big blow came from Landry Jones. His 76-yard touchdown pass to tight end James Hanna with 2:34 left made it 47-38. Jones finished with 468 passing yards, a career high, on 37 completions in 62 attempts, with four touchdowns and three interceptions. Oklahoma State kicked a late field goal, and after a failed onside kick the Sooners closed out the win.

The result left Oklahoma, Oklahoma State and Texas A&M all at 6-2 in Big 12 play, sharing the South Division. Oklahoma went on to beat Nebraska 23-20 in the Big 12 Championship Game on December 4 and then topped Connecticut 48-20 in the Fiesta Bowl.
